title: RapidIO logical / transport layer endpoint: NREAD / NWRITE / NWRITE_R / SWRITE / MAINTENANCE / DOORBELL target, doorbell initiator, LP-Serial CRC-16, 1 KB memory

regs.name: BASE_ID_CFG
regs.desc: Base device ID loaded by CMD.id_load

fields.desc: 1 = write MEM_WDATA at MEM_ADDR (dropped if a packet writes the same octet in that clock)
1 = send the doorbell (when STATUS.ob_busy = 0 and the endpoint is idle)
our doorbell is waiting for its response
a packet is being executed or sent (new packets are dropped)

regs.name: RX_REP
regs.desc: Received packet report, one per packet; reading it frees it

fdesc.rx_why: 0 executed, 1 CRC error, 2 not for this endpoint, 3 malformed, 4 unsupported, 5 request error (ERROR response), 6 dropped (busy), 7 unexpected response
fdesc.rx_ftype: ftype of the packet (0 when dropped)

regs.name: DOORBELL
regs.desc: Received doorbell; reading the last word frees it

regs.name: OB_DONE
regs.desc: Our doorbell's response; reading it frees it

fdesc.ob_status: response status (0 DONE, 7 ERROR, others as received)

features: Target for NREAD, NWRITE, NWRITE_R and SWRITE on a 1 KB memory, with the RapidIO rdsize / wrsize table (sub-double-word lanes, 8 to 256 octets)
MAINTENANCE read / write of the CARs, base device ID CSR, host base device ID lock and component tag; DOORBELL in and out
8-bit and 16-bit device IDs, responses with priority + 1, DONE / ERROR status
LP-Serial CRC-16 with the early CRC after octet 80 and padding, checked on receive and generated on transmit
notes: rx_valid / rx_data / rx_last carry a packet one octet per PCLK (from the ackID octet to the pad); tx_valid / tx_data / tx_last give the packets the endpoint sends, without back pressure.
Not implemented: the physical layer (control symbols, ackID tracking, retry), message passing, atomics, flow control, request timeouts, 34 / 50 / 66-bit addresses.
sequence: Set the CARs, write BASE_ID_CFG and pulse CMD.id_load; preload memory with MEM_ADDR / MEM_WDATA / CMD.host_wr.
Read RX_REP for each received packet and DOORBELL for each doorbell; send a doorbell with OB_CTRL / OB_INFO / CMD.ob_start and read OB_DONE for its response.
